tests.name: backup health reports the newest complete dump in Capsid's /health shape, and skips an incomplete newer run
backup health with no complete dump is a warning, not a missing field
backup health that cannot read the bucket says so rather than throwing
flat prune (retentionDays or minKept given) keeps by age with a floor of the newest complete runs, and an incomplete run holds no slot
flat prune keeps a run inside retention even past the floor
prune deletes nothing while no complete run exists, which is what a wrong bucket looks like
graduated prune keeps exactly the expected set over a 200 day history with a missing day and a second run in one day
graduated prune crosses a year boundary: December's copy and the week of New Year both survive
graduated prune never removes the newest complete run, even when it is old, and ages out old incomplete runs only
graduated prune takes its windows from a policy the caller passes
selectStaleRuns is the rule pruneDumps applies, over run ids alone and in any input order
a good dump passes every check, and the scratch database is deleted
a 141 KB value with newlines and quotes restores byte for byte, and no statement sent is over the cap
the guard throws on a statement over the cap before it reaches the database

a dropped FTS5 rebuild fails the fts and search checks, though every table restored
a stale dump fails the drill, and maxAgeHours: null turns the check off
an empty bucket fails the drill without creating a scratch database
a scratch database that cannot be deleted is reported by name
a row lost after the restore's own count check fails the drill's recount
a downloaded directory is a read-only bucket the drill runs from
the REST scratch adapter creates, fills and deletes a database named restore-drill-*

a table holding a BLOB cannot be bound over REST, and says so
only node.ts imports node:, so the package entry bundles into a Worker

a restore whose table file lost rows is refused
options that name no table are refused, so an exclude list cannot rot
sidecars are written before the marker and listed in it
